description: Implementation of the Bbr2StartupMode class, part of the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm in QUIC, managing startup phase behavior including bandwidth growth detection, loss handling, and pacing adjustments.

classes.name: Bbr2StartupMode
classes.description: Implements the startup phase of the BBRv2 congestion control algorithm, managing bandwidth estimation, loss detection, and pacing adjustments during startup.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Bbr2StartupMode
methods.description: Constructor initializing startup mode, incrementing slowstart count and starting slowstart duration timer.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Enter
methods.description: Method should not be called; logs a bug if invoked.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Leave
methods.description: Stops slowstart timer and clears bandwidth low estimate.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, checks for bandwidth growth, loss conditions, and adjusts pacing gain accordingly.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::CheckExcessiveLosses
methods.description: Checks for excessive packet loss and exits startup if loss threshold exceeded.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports internal debug state for diagnostics.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs debug state information to stream.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode::Params
methods.description: Returns current parameters for startup mode.
